explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/164 (the Erdős primitive set conjecture, proved by Lichtman): for every primitive A ⊆ ℕ with all elements ≥ 2, Σ 1/(a log a) ≤ Σ_p 1/(p log p). Excluding 1 is necessary, since log 1 = 0. The tsum on the left is never a junk 0 masking divergence, because primitive sets have convergent sums (Erdős 1935). Formal proof linked.
